stories.title: Define Trial Phase Score Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define a normalized schema for trial phase quality including fields: phase_enum (I, II, III, IV, UNKNOWN), phase_score (numeric), and explanation text for downstream consumers.

stories.title: Implement Trial Phase Scoring Logic
stories.description: Implement deterministic scoring logic mapping normalized trial phases to quality scores (e.g., Phase IV highest, Phase I lowest, UNKNOWN default) within clinical_trials_service.

stories.title: Expose Trial Phase Quality via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate trial phase scoring into evaluate_care_facade so that each clinical trial result includes phase_enum, score, and explanation in the response payload.

stories.title: Unit Tests for Trial Phase Normalization and Scoring
stories.description: Create unit tests validating phase extraction normalization (I–IV, UNKNOWN) and correct score assignment across all phase values including edge cases and missing data.

stories.title: End-to-End Integration of Trial Phase Quality in Clinical Trial Results
stories.description: Validate end-to-end flow from ClinicalTrials.gov ingestion through normalization, scoring, and facade response to ensure trial phase quality is consistently present and correctly formatted.
